text: {"sections":[{"heading":"Summary","claims":[{"text":"For Synthetic Model 04 (mortgage prepayment) under checklist MR-2026.1, 11 of 12 checklist items are present and no critical checklist gaps are reported; the documentation status is remediation needed because MR-5 is empty and MR-4 performance testing is weak.","citations":[{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MEASURE 2.6"},{"doc_id":"eu_ai_act","locator":"Article 15"},{"doc_id":"mdl-04-development_report","locator":"line 23"}]}]},{"heading":"Checklist gaps","claims":[{"text":"MR-5 is empty, so the documentation does not provide sensitivity and stress testing content.","citations":[{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MEASURE 2.6"},{"doc_id":"eu_ai_act","locator":"Article 15"}]}]},{"heading":"Section assessments","claims":[{"text":"MR-4 is weak because the documented performance testing reports fitted historical performance but does not state holdout or out-of-time test results or a tolerance or benchmark for that testing.","citations":[{"doc_id":"mdl-04-development_report","locator":"line 23"},{"doc_id":"mdl-04-development_report","locator":"line 24"},{"doc_id":"mdl-04-development_report","locator":"line 25"},{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MEASURE 2.1"},{"doc_id":"eu_ai_act","locator":"Article 15"}]}]},{"heading":"Matters for the validator","claims":[{"text":"The validator should ask the model owner for sensitivity and stress testing documentation for MR-5, including the scenarios or shocks tested and how results are evaluated.","citations":[{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MEASURE 2.6"},{"doc_id":"eu_ai_act","locator":"Article 15"}]},{"text":"The validator should also look for independent performance evidence for MR-4, such as holdout or out-of-time results and the benchmark or tolerance used to judge performance, because the current section only documents fitted historical measures.","citations":[{"doc_id":"mdl-04-development_report","locator":"line 23"},{"doc_id":"mdl-04-development_report","locator":"line 24"},{"doc_id":"mdl-04-development_report","locator":"line 25"},{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MEASURE 2.1"},{"doc_id":"nist_ai_rmf","locator":"MEASURE 2.5"}]}]}]}
